0113f763 Window overlap.  1 to 32.  Default = 4.  Increase this to reduce 'tremolo' effect.  Increasing it by a factor of 2 doubles the CPU usage.
0113f7ed Maximum channels supported.  0 to 16.  0 = same as fmod's default output polyphony, 1 = mono, 2 = stereo etc.  See remarks for more.  Default = 0.  It is suggested to leave at 0!
